QF.id: I Clearing Settlement and Risk Management_66

question.text: What is the calendar spread margin (in INR) for a 1-month USDINR spread position in currency futures?

explanation.text: The Logic: The calendar-spread table on page 174 shows USDINR 1-month spread margin as Rs. 500. The Trap: Rs. 750, Rs. 1,575 and Rs. 1,600 are spread values for other pairs/tenors and should not be substituted for USDINR 1-month. Note: Page 176 adds that ELM on a calendar-spread position is levied on one-third of the far-month MTM value, which is part of the same calendar-spread treatment.
